name: Wit of the Eroding Shore
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level: jester 3

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area: 10-ft.-radius burst
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Will half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

Every creature within the area of effect suffers 2d6 points of phrenic damage, plus an additional point for each caster level. The target is subjected to the ‘staggered’ condition. This condition lasts until a successful saving throw is made.

For the duration of the encounter, once per round when you hit an enemy that failed a save versus this spell with a prank (0-level jester spell), that enemy is subjected to the ‘grappled’ condition. This condition lasts until the end of your next turn.
